newsitem.title: USA: NYS Urban Dev. plans $600 mln bond sale Oct 14 wk.
newsitem.headline: NYS Urban Dev. plans $600 mln bond sale Oct 14 wk.

text.p: The New York State Urban Development Corp, which had to be bailed out by the state in 1975, now plans to sell around $600 million of bonds around the week of October 14, a finance official said on Friday.
"We expect to have the bond prospectus probably within the next week and hit the market the next week, the week of October 14," said Joe Branca, chief financial officier for Empire State Development.
The state agency is the umbrella organization for several entities, including the Urban Development Corp, which last tapped the capital markets in 1974.

Branca earlier had anticipated selling the debt, which could go as high as around $623 million, because that is the amount of outstanding issues that need to be refunded, during the week of October 7.
No explanation for the slight delay was immediately available.
